RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the December 1, 2006/Agrahayana 10, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and
Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Environment and Forests; Health and Family Welfare;
Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Strengthening NPPA
*141. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of  CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the prices of
essential drugs are fluctuating very fast;
(b) if so, the details of steps taken in
this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority
(NPPA) is unable to control price
fluctuations; and
(d) if so, the remedial  steps taken to
strengthen the NPPA?
Allocation of imported  wheat
*142. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the allocation of wheat imported,
State-wise; and
(b) the details of quality of
specifications given while importing
wheat?
Chief Ministers' meeting on polio
*143. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had convened a meeting of the Chief
Ministers of those States which have seen
a recent resurgence of polio cases;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that cases of
polio have been reported from many parts
of the country; and
(d) if so, the details of the cases of polio
that have been reported, State-wise?
Brain drain from Railways
†*144. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of  RAILWAYS  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the brilliant
and competent officers of Railways are
leaving Railways  in order to join the private
sector companies;
(b) whether major projects like
dedicated freight corridor are likely to be
affected by this brain drain;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Railways to prevent such exodus;
(d) whether Railways have lowered the
age limit for the Divisional Railway
Manager from 52 years to 50 years; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?
Pesticide contents in cola drinks
*145. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the products of Coca-Cola
and Pepsi-Cola contain pesticides which
are harmful for human consumption;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken against Cola companies for
manufacturing such harmful drinks;
(c) whether the Bureau of Indian
Standards (BIS) has fixed any norms for
the manufacturing of cola drinks and if so,
the details thereof;
(d) whether the cola drinks, available in
the market, meet BIS standards; and
(e) if not, the action taken to stop the
manufacturing/marketing of such harmful
products?
Vaccine for dengue and chikungunya
†*146.  SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
 SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
 Will the Minister of  HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that dengue and
chikungunya/malaria is becoming an
epidemic in the country;
(b) if so, whether Government are going
to invent any vaccine for preventing these
diseases;
(c) whether  Government have
conducted any research in this regard; and
(d) if so, the present status in this
regard?
Availability of professionals in
emergency at the Safdarjung Hospital
*147. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the medical
professionals like plastic surgeons,
anaesthetists, physiotherapists,
orthopaedic surgeons, etc. were available
round the clock for the treatment of Sarojini
Nagar bomb blast victims and Meerut fire
victims in the Department of Burns and
Plastic Surgery of the Safdarjung Hospital;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a  fact that the
above mentained professionals are also
available on call in the Department of Burns
and Plastic Surgery of that hospital in case
of emergency; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Luxury train from Mumbai to
 Kolkata
*148. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR : Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Railways
have tied up with the Cox and Kings to run
a luxury train from Mumbai to Kolkata;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how many such trains are being
considered by the Indian Railways Catering
and Tourism Corporation; and

47

introduction of such trains and destinations
thereof?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the December 1, 2006/Agrahayana 10, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
Assistance for rain deficient States
†1019. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the name of the States of the
Northern India which have less rainfall than
the expected rain fall in the present
monsoon season;
(b) the steps Government have been
taken for the farmers of these States, so
far;
(c) the name of the States where special
packages for farmers have been given due
to no rainfall; and
(d) the details of the fund allocated to
the States, State-wise?
Integrated development of TBOs
1020. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a Central Scheme known as
Integrated Development of Tree Borne
Oilseeds (TBOs) is being implemented
under the Tenth Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the components of the scheme; and
(c) the amount spent on this scheme so
far, State-wise?
Production of pulses
1021. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
production of pulses in the country is not
sufficient to cope up with their demand;
(b) the current level of production and
demand of different pulses and projection
for next five years; and
(c) the steps taken to increase
production of pulses and meanwhile bridge
the gap between demand and supply?
NAIS in Rajasthan
1022. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA : Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the crops presently covered in
Rajasthan under the National Agricultural
Insurance Scheme;
(b) whether the State Government have
sought the intervention of the Central
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

238
Government to include certain other
perennial crops in the scheme;
(c) whether Government would
consider to accord sanction for the above
proposals, if any, and the reaction of
Government thereto;
(d) why a farmer, particularly a marginal
farmer, usually hesitates to undertake an
insurance cover under NAIS and what
hassles he has to face; and
(e) what steps the Central Government
intends to take to help the farmers and the
make NAIS more acceptable and farmer
friendly?
Development of pulses
†1023. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the average production of pulses
viz., moong, urad, arhar, chaula, masoor and
moth before the green revolution and their
present production, State-wise yield per
acre;
(b) whether it is a fact that whole efforts
concentrated on increasing the production
of wheat during the green revolution and
development of pulses remained neglected;
and
(c) the scheme for development of
pulses at present and whether world level
production would be possible from the
same?
Co-ordination Committee on
agricultural development
and policy
1024. SHRI C. RAMACHAN-
DRAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Co-ordination Committee
has been Constituted to focus on
agricultural development and policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have identified
the key areas that require fresh policy
initiatives; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
National Policy on Farmers
1025. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Commission on Farmers has suggested
Government to formulate a National Policy
on Farmers;
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this regard; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Commission had also suggested
Government to focus more on the economic
well being of the farmers feeding the nation?
Making Patwari Halka as an unit
under NAIS
†1026. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL:
SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a proposal has been sent
by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to
the Central Government that Patwari Halka
may be treated as a unit for purposes of
Crop Insurance Scheme;
(b) whether Government have accepted
the proposal; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

239
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and by
when it is likely to be accepted?

sector in the heartland of the green
revolution, Punjab;
